//: The image builds the frontend on its own, with no backend source present.
The root tsconfig type-checks the test files too, which is right for local
work and for CI: vitest runs them and a type error in a test is a real error.
But one of them — permissionMatcher.agreement.test.ts — deliberately imports
backend source, so `tsc` on the frontend alone cannot resolve it and the
Tests are not shipped, so they are not part of the production build. They
stay in the root config, where the test run still type-checks them.
